main_claim: Distinct, overlapping constraints limit when morphology is measurement sufficient.

a.claim: Reporter recoverability is associated with overlapping stability and coverage constraints.
a.aggregation: unweighted median of ten frozen reporter-level held-out-gene Pearson scores
a.boundary: Associations and a three-term in-sample joint model; cross-screen consistency is shown descriptively but is not a joint-model term; no independent causal attribution.

b.claim: Low recoverability can reflect unstable target responses across wells and guide halves.
b.statistical_units: 3 well pairs; 3 deterministic guide-half partitions; 100 random-cell-half draws per case
b.ordering: pRb then NPM1; within each case well, guide, random
b.image_boundary: pRb SALL3 same-guide well medoids are descriptive anchors, not the correlation units.

c.claim: Response rank can persist despite amplitude contraction.
c.statistical_unit: reporter, with 1,000 genes nested per reporter
c.aggregation: element-wise unweighted median of ten aligned OOF response profiles, followed by metrics

d.claim: NTC environment shift is associated with whole-screen transfer loss.
d.x_scale: raw RMS standardized difference displayed on a logarithmic axis
d.highlight_selection: All two destination directions of the frozen FeRhoNox repeated-reporter failure case; these are the first- and second-ranked transfer losses among the 81 displayed directions, but the case is not a prevalence sample.
d.image_boundary: Within each screen, the displayed FeRhoNox NTC cell is the prespecified soft-QC non-edge phase/geometry medoid; transfer outcome was not used to select the cell. The selected failure case and the association do not establish causation or prevalence.

e.claim: Morphology-nearest cells can retain targeted-state discrepancy.
e.definition: per-gene median nearest-neighbour endpoint RMS divided by deterministic all-eligible-pairs reference, then median/IQR across genes
e.boundary: raw-thumbnail sensitivity is not a raw-image learner upper bound or irreducible error estimate.
